question: Can the source's correctness join mix outcomes across model identities when task/perturbation identifiers are shared?
prior_information: Source loader and merge keys inspected; public table coverage and author aggregate statistics already recomputed. Raw correctness records are not released in the acquired artifact.
design: Two controlled model rows share task/perturbation. The high-cost row is correct and the low-cost row incorrect. Supply corresponding two correctness rows. Compare original source aggregation against explicitly model-keyed one-to-one aggregation.
checks: Equal per-model correctness as negative control
Missing model identity must fail the repaired join
Duplicate complete keys must fail rather than expand rows
claims_boundary: A controlled counterexample identifies a source-code failure condition, not the magnitude or occurrence of error in unreleased author runs. No new agent/LLM invocation or natural correctness claim.
